canonical.title: A weekend at Les Prés d'Eugénie: walk to a 3-star dinner, day-trip the Tursan ring

sources.title: Les Prés d'Eugénie — Michelin Guide listing
sources.claim: Les Prés d'Eugénie has held three Michelin stars since 1977.

sources.title: Eugénie-les-Bains — Guide des Landes
sources.claim: Eugénie-les-Bains is a village of ~500 inhabitants.

sources.title: Eugénie-les-Bains hotels — TripAdvisor
sources.claim: TripAdvisor lists only five hotel properties for the whole village.

sources.title: Les Prés d'Eugénie — Rooms & Suites
sources.claim: Couvent des Herbes annex rooms start at €330; Logis de la Ferme aux Grives is the rustic option.

sources.title: Maison Rose — Les Prés d'Eugénie
sources.claim: Maison Rose 3-star annex rooms start at €160 on the same domain.

sources.title: Les Prés d'Eugénie — estate site
sources.claim: Guérard buildings (Maison, Couvent des Herbes, Logis de la Ferme aux Grives, Maison Rose) share gardens, heated pool and spa within 0–150 m.

sources.title: Hôtel Le Relais des Champs — Booking
sources.claim: Le Relais des Champs (€80–90) is 300 m from the dining room, the best independent fallback.

sources.title: Aire-sur-l'Adour taxis — Guide des Landes
sources.claim: Local taxis are not on-demand; after-dinner pickup needs ≥12 h advance booking.

sources.title: Église Sainte-Quitterie — Tourisme Aire–Eugénie
sources.claim: Sainte-Quitterie crypt: UNESCO; 4th-c. white-marble sarcophagus; free 45-min guided tours 1 Jul–14 Sep.

sources.title: Maison Lassaubatju — Chambres d'hôtes
sources.claim: Lassaubatju (Hontanx) working Armagnac distillery sleep + on-estate tasting from €88.

sources.title: Abbaye bénédictine et son abbatiale — Saint-Sever
sources.claim: Saint-Sever Benedictine abbey-church (UNESCO) has rare seven-staggered-apses choir.

sources.title: Salle du Trésor — Beatus de Saint-Sever
sources.claim: Treasure Room with Beatus facsimile open through 31 Dec 2026.

sources.title: Domaine de Paguy
sources.claim: Domaine de Paguy (Betbezer-d'Armagnac) is ~22 km from Eugénie inside the lodging ring.

sources.title: Marché hebdomadaire — Aire-sur-l'Adour
sources.claim: Aire-sur-l'Adour weekly market: Tuesday and Saturday, 8:00–12:30.

sources.title: Crypte de Saint-Girons — Hagetmau
sources.claim: Hagetmau's Romanesque crypt closes Sunday and Monday.

sources.title: Château de Bachen — Les Prés d'Eugénie
sources.claim: Château de Bachen (Guérards' Tursan vineyard, 8 km) reservation-only Mon–Fri at 10:00 or 15:00.

sources.title: Mars@Hack 2026 — CCI Landes
sources.claim: Mars@Hack CTF at CCI Landes (Mont-de-Marsan) — early March, weekday.
